name: Tolu
blurb: A young woman dealing with digital stalking, institutional inaction, and victim-blaming.

nodes.text: Tolu receives notifications while finishing her shift.
I saw you leaving work. Why didn't you wave back?
Seeking help online and offline yields no protection.

doors.label: Police Station Desk
doors.text: Has he physically harmed you yet? Come back if something happens.

doors.label: Platform Support
doors.text: Automated reply: Report reviewed. No violation of community standards found.

doors.label: Friend
doors.text: Just block him and stop posting your location so publicly.

doors.label: Family Elder
doors.text: Change your phone number and dress more conservatively.
